_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/test_mana_doesnt_empty.py. t_mde_keep adds {G}{G} that survives steps and phases until end of turn; t_mde_plain is the identical spell without the rider, the control that proves the assertions are about the rider and not about sorceries. Both cost {0} so a position needs no lands and the pool under test holds only what the spell put there.

cards.name: Test Kept Mana
cards.oracle_text: Add {G}{G}. Until end of turn, you don't lose this mana as steps and phases end.
